The *Dutiyanānātitthiya Sutta* ("Second Discourse on Various Sectarians") is the fifth discourse of the sixth chapter (*Jaccandhavagga*) of the *Udāna* (PTS Ud 69) in the Khuddaka Nikāya. In this sutta, wanderers belonging to diverse non-Buddhist sects engage in contentious disputes regarding speculative views about the self, the nature of pleasure and pain, and the cosmos.
